evidence: doctor_eligibility.go: a memorycard page joins by memory id, any other page through the import_map-derived EngramID (first in id order, as MemoryByEngramID); a page naming no memory or no live memory is skipped.
The advice uses the memory's own id: `promote --source memorycard --id M` or a pin in memorycard; golden 58's only changed line is that advice.
promote.PageMemoryRef checks memorycard identity first, then engram, and requires a positive integer id.

cmd_doctor.go liveMemoryEligibility opens only memorycard (ListMemories: active and superseded, archived excluded, id order) and makes no Engram call; EngramID is 0 when the import_map key is not numeric.

Tests: doctor_eligibility_memorycard_test.go (memorycard join, legacy join, no cross-join, pass cases) and cmd doctor_eligibility_test.go (absent Engram DB, memorycard read failure, advice for a frozen memorycard page). Static read only.
